decision.reasoning_trace: My search for a Bluetooth speaker was cluttered with accessories like cases and batteries, which made browsing frustrating. Among the actual speakers, the Bose SoundLink Color II was the most appealing but carried a high price tag ($124.95) and some concerning feedback about its longevity. The JBL Clip 3 was a good price but is a renewed unit, and I prefer buying new electronics for battery reliability. The other budget options from brands like Raymate and EDUPLINK offered interesting features, but I am hesitant to commit to lesser-known brands for audio equipment without more consistent long-term reviews. I've decided not to purchase anything today and will wait for a sale on a new, name-brand unit.
